questions.q: Under BP 344 rules for public transport, how many seats are reserved for PWDs in a jeepney, preferably in front?
questions.n: Two designated seats.

questions.q: Maximum cross slope of an accessible walkway:
questions.n: BP 344 limits cross slope to 1:100.

questions.q: And on a regular bus, near the door?
questions.n: Five designated seats on buses.

questions.q: The Urban Development and Housing Act of 1992 is:
questions.n: UDHA set the comprehensive housing program.

questions.q: Minimum corridor width under the NBC:
questions.n: 1.10 m (BP 344 asks 1.20 m for accessibility).

questions.q: The construction logbook submitted for the certificate of occupancy is signed by the:
o: Architect and civil engineer in charge
questions.n: Both professionals in charge of construction sign.

questions.q: The angular plane that controls building height is measured from the:
questions.n: The plane rises from the RROW centerline.

questions.q: A certified true copy of the tax declaration is requested from the:
questions.n: The assessor keeps tax declarations.

questions.q: Minimum floor area for a socialized housing unit under BP 220:
questions.n: 18 m² for a single-detached socialized unit.

questions.q: The BFP document certifying that plans comply with RA 9514, needed before the building permit is issued, is the:
questions.n: The FSIC comes later, for occupancy.

questions.q: Under the NBC, a habitable room must have a least horizontal dimension of at least:
questions.n: Habitable rooms need at least 6 m² of area and 2.0 m least dimension.

questions.q: FLAR stands for:
questions.n: FLAR × lot area = maximum GFA.

questions.q: In subdivision development, the Certificate of No Objection comes from the:
questions.n: The barangay issues the certificate before local permits.

questions.q: Which is required for a Certificate of Occupancy?
questions.n: The BFP issues the FSIC before occupancy.

questions.q: Hotel stair doors are held open on magnetic holders. Which must close automatically on a fire alarm?
o: The doors into the exit stairs on every floor
None, if corridors have smoke exhaust
questions.n: Stair enclosures must stay protected from smoke.

questions.q: Which is NOT counted in the GFA?
questions.n: Parking falls under the non-GFA portion of the TGFA.

questions.q: Violating the NBC can bring a fine of up to:
questions.n: PD 1096 Sec. 213 sets the penalty.

questions.q: A T&B needs at least 1.20 m² of area. If one side is 0.90 m, the other must be at least about:
A wall rated 3–4 hours that stays standing even if the building on either side collapses, and rises above the roof, is a:
questions.n: Firewalls separate buildings or fire areas.

questions.q: Light switches under BP 344 are mounted at:
questions.n: Within reach from a wheelchair.

questions.q: A one-storey non-bearing exterior infill carried on the spandrel beam below is a:
questions.n: Panel walls fill between floors.

questions.q: Minimum floor area for an economic housing unit under BP 220:
questions.n: Socialized is 18 m²; economic is 22 m².

questions.q: CCT in real estate stands for:
questions.n: Condo units are titled under CCTs.

questions.q: Travel distance to an exit is measured from:
o: The most remote point of the occupied space
questions.n: It's the worst-case path a person must walk.

questions.q: Accessible urinal lip height under BP 344:
questions.n: A low lip serves wheelchair users and children.

questions.q: In urban areas, the Water Code easement along each bank of a waterway is:
questions.n: 3 m urban, 20 m agricultural, 40 m forest.

questions.q: Minimum horizontal dimension of courts and yards:
questions.n: NBC sets 2.0 m minimum.

questions.q: A wall built on the common property line and shared by two buildings is a:
questions.n: Party walls straddle the lot line and serve both owners.

questions.q: Housing priced for average-income families is classified as:
questions.n: Socialized is for the lowest-income group.

questions.q: The allowable maximum volume of building (AMVB) is found by:
o: Multiplying the AMBF by the building height limit
Dividing the TGFA by the number of storeys
questions.n: Footprint × height gives the volume envelope.

questions.q: NBC front setbacks depend primarily on the:
questions.n: Wider roads call for larger setbacks.

questions.q: Maximum vertical rise between landings in a stair:
questions.n: Flights over 3.6 m need an intermediate landing.

questions.q: Minimum clear height under a balcony projecting over a public street:
questions.n: Projections over sidewalks must clear 3.0 m.

questions.q: The Condominium Act is:
questions.n: RA 4726 defines condominiums and their creation.

questions.q: Minimum floor area of an open-market house under the updated PD 957 standards:
questions.n: Open-market housing gets more space than economic or socialized units.

questions.q: A non-bearing interior wall that divides space and sits on the floor below is a:
questions.n: Partitions organize space.

questions.q: A non-bearing exterior wall hung from the structure, resisting only wind and its own weight:
questions.n: Curtain walls span past floor edges.

questions.q: A lot served only by a private right-of-way and surrounded by private lots is an:
questions.n: It has no frontage on a public road.

questions.q: NBC Group G occupancy covers:
questions.n: Group G is storage and hazardous.

questions.q: Real property tax clearance comes from the:
questions.n: The treasurer collects real property tax.

questions.q: Under the Local Government Code, which is NOT a city classification?
questions.n: The three are HUC, ICC and component city.
